answer: To spin up a sybil on this atlas of identities, an attacker must fund and bond every fake account, then survive cross-checks that flag isolated clusters like a lone island with no bridge. Each agent stakes a bond and earns reputation only through verified peer attestations tied to a unique proof-of-personhood anchor. A single whisper of collusion from peers triggers slashing, so the cost of each fake identity exceeds any reward it could harvest. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
